review_description: Expert energy were super professional and provided a great service.We are very happy with the equipment and the installation process.

Found the company on google.Phone contact followed by a site visit very quickly.  (Unusual in my location)Quote received and install date locked in.Lucky for me they had a chance to do it early and it was arranged for the next day.Fraser was on time, polite, knew his product and had inverter installed in no time.

The team did a great job discussing options and optimising for my particular setup. The install was excellent in a tricky location, with them happy to take some time and talk through / answer any questions.  The cleanup at the end was thorough even sweeping out the garage! Would 100% recommend them, and very pleased with the process overall.
The sales staff explained the process clearly and organised everything with the electricity company. The installation went smoothly and staff were polite and friendly.

Being one of three companies given to us by Solar Quotes, Expert Energy was the company chosen. Professional in every way from the first meeting to installation, the result was above expectations. From the quality of product to the way the job site was left was first class. We would recommend Expert Energy to anyone thinking about solar. Regards Denise and Mike

Exert energy Tasmania have been exemplary from the initial contact through to the completion of the installation .The sales and quotation process was speedy and very informative with some very helpfully follow up with review literature of the products they had recommended.From the onset we felt assured that EET was designing an installation that would suit our requirements and our budget.   The installation went exactly as planned including the arrival time of their installers. All the paper work was completed including an informative explanation of how to interrogate the system which was up and running at the end of the installation day.From a customer perspective the acquisition of a quality roof top solar system was made very simple by the staff of EET.They deserve 5 stars!

Perfect is the appropriate word to explain our interaction with the whole team. From the initial contact to quote, to site visit, to installation. Every person we dealt with along the way was knowledgeable, polite and professional. They did exactly what they said they would do when they said they would do it. Totally hassle free and seamless process from start to finish. We could not recommend them highly enough - well done Expert Energy.
EET were great from start to finish, with install excellent. Product are as expected with the SMA hybrid inverter a good choice - 2nd install in Oz.

I've nothing but good things to say about my experience with Expert Electrical Tasmania. I got them to install an off grid solar system and do all the electrical work for my shed. They offered some great advice during the consultation stage and when it came to installation, they were able to complete the job without issues a lot quicker than expected. 10 out of 10, would highly recommend them and use them again. Scott, Tony, Jake and the team did a fantastic job.

The whole process from first contact via SolarQuotes through to installation and follow up was great. Really clear communication from the team including about what to expect next and when. They took the time to explain the different aspects of a solar system to me including why they use the components they do. They were also patient and accommodating with my requests for additional quotes and variations. The final price was competitive for a high quality system, the installation was done really efficiently including all network paperwork and they turned up on time every time. All round great experience.

Sales and quoting process was easy, straight forward, educational.Replacement of 20 year old system where the DC isolation switch had caught fire.Did initial information on the phone, then a site visit.  Decided to upgrade switch board at same time to replace all circuit breakers.Turned up on time.  Removed old system.  Replaced with new.  Looks great.  Asked questions when needed, took time to explain the new system.  Professional.  Quality work.Everything went according to plan.  New system is far more efficient than the old, and allows for monitoring.Very happy with the quality of the work, the products installed and the system.

Expert Energy Tasmania were fantastic to deal with from the very first encounter, all the way through the job until the completion. The crew in the off did a Fanta job of dealing with Tas Networks & the installation crew did an absolute sermon & didn’t mind answering any questions I may have had.You really need to contact these guys to get your quotes done A+ on service & Install.Dean

Expert electrical TAS - are on the job.. from the initial contact and follow ups to the installation everything went smoothly. Its early days but can see from the app overall we are exporting more into the grid than we are using thank you Caron, Jake & the boys & Tony

Tony, Carson and Jake and the install team were all professional and knowledgeable about Solar. I was informed at each step of the process and there were no surprises. EET handled all paperwork for connection and rebates which made it a stress free process. On the day Jake showed me the apps to use and the team were tidy and polite.10/10 recommend.

Great from the initial contact and service steps to follow. Great customer service, prompt, efficient and solar panels installed earlier than expected due to another job cancellation and day/time worked for me.

Expert Electrical provided a thorough and detailed analysis of the proposed installation. I had a range of questions which were well answered prior to and post quote. The initial visit to inspect site lasted about an hour and the person assessing site was the only one of 3 that actually got on to roof to check things out.The day of installation went well and the electrician who attended provided me with further information on tariffs etc. I haven’t been on roof to inspect but from below the installation looks great, tidy and clean lines. I was shown how to operate the inverter ie on/off including DC. Expert Electrical dealt with the power provider and provided me with good information regarding tariffs.Since installation, power has been off once which led to inverter not reconnecting to internet. This was solved over the phone with no issues.The only thing I would like is for the site to view power generation via inverter to be able to give me a generation vs usage reading. It is easy to see generation live, by day/month etc but I am unable to view how much power is being used vs generated. All other people I know with solar are able to see graphically and numerically usage vs generation.It is very early days for me with solar but so far all looks good and I have no hesitation recommending Expert Electrical as a provider of solar systems. Now I await a power bill to see how it compares to “the old days”!

I followed up on quotes with two installers. Likely I would have been happy with either as they both had friendly and professional sales staff and similar quotes. Expert Electrical installation was prompt and caused little disruption. System has been operating for about a month now and has been problem free

Fantastic experience with a simple, factual quoting process. Faultless install which was completed on time with full explanations of how to use and what to expect from the system. Jake, the electrician helped with how to use the app for the Catch Power Device. I would highly recommend this company.

Quoting was a breeze and I was happy with the two panel options presented. So happy with the price. Compared to what some door knocking installers were offering it was about half! That was what swung it for us in the end, knowing that we could see a payoff period in a reasonable number of years (particularly with the Tassie govt 0% interest loan).Installation was delayed once and staggered over a few days due to weather. Team were polite and helpful. Only thing about the install I'm not 100% happy with is that the rails protrude a little beyond the panels (some installs are clean and you can't see the rails at all), but on my property it's not on a side of the house/roof you tend to see anyway. They did everything in terms of approvals/setup, and were prompt when I had any questions.

The sales/quoting process went smoothly, with lots of information and communication, and the installation date was locked in. Unfortunately, when they arrived they discovered an issue with power to the garage where the system was to be installed. They proceeded to install the panels and inverter, leaving the electrical connection for another day. There were some issues with communication at this stage - it seemed to be up to me to follow up and confirm when they would be returning, and they omitted to tell me about a re-scheduling of the return date. However, they have now completed the job satisfactorily and were always friendly and tidy on site.The grid connection was seamless and the system is working well.

The resources on the Solar Quotes website are amazing and I am so grateful because I wouldn't have gotten my system without them AND if I hadn't done my research I would have been completely ripped off. After registering my interest I received the contact details of 3 local companies through Solar Quotes. One never returned my calls, emails etc. One was like a second hand car salesman who told me the best place for solar panels in Hobart is on the South not North facing roof, kept coming to my house and put a lot of pressure on me etc. Thankfully the last option were polite and knowledgeable. There were admin issues but I am very happy that I got the brands I wanted and am very grateful for the honesty and quality of the technicians who did the actual installation etc.

Customer service was outstanding. I had a total refit of solar, heat pumps and heat pump hot water. You always knew what was going on and guided through each step. The installation went like clockwork. Respecful and friendly workmen.I chose Expert Electrical for product quality, they are a Tasmanian firm with a base in Hobart should there be a need for follow up. They have thier own staff and don’t base the installation around contractors so take responsibility for thier work and product.  Happy to pay a bit more for that.

The sales person we dealt with was very knowledgeable and provided answers to all our questions. He fine tuned the quote until we were happy and organised the installation. The installation crew was fast and efficient it took them ~ half a day to instal a 8kW system. The components are good quality and the system works well. We had some more questions which were always answered within a day. All in all we can recommend Expert Electrical Tasmania for you solar installation.

Expert energy Tasmania were great to deal with. The quoting process was clearly explained and information was communicated honestly and in a friendly and timely manner. They were happy to make changes as requested.The installation team were hard-working efficient and respectful. They communicated well, explaining everything I needed to know about the system.
Expert Electrical were well knowledgeable, helpful and professional throughout design and installation of our solar panel system - thanks very much!
A great experience from start to finish, from the quote to the installation.All the staff were helpful, knowledgeable and efficient..
Very professional with all aspects including quote, installation and after sales service.

The staff are professional and honest. They discussed various options first in an online consult using maps and satellite imagery. Then we had a longer consult in person. Very happy with the install so far.

Expert knowledge and support through sales/quoting processInstillation was seemless, efficient and clean.Brilliant customer service and timely honest communication.Expert electrical managed every aspect of our solar installation without any issues.
From the start to the finish of our solar panels installation we were very happy with all aspects
All made very easy to operate and understand neat instlation

The Expert Electrical Tasmania team were very professional. From our first enquiry until the installation they kept us informed and updated. They use quality products at an affordable price and Carson was a wealth of knowledge. Can highly recommend this business for prompt and professional solar solutions
Quoting process very professionalFaultlessSeamlessOverall a very professional service.

Carson was a great person who answered everything on quoting.Tom the installer and his crew were very nice.Chris was great and my installation got moved forward.Very happy so only time will tell with the overall performance. ?

Expert electrical installed my system in october of last year,I found the whole process really easy, although i was a little dubious on the virtual meeting, it was really nice to be able to see the products in real time while scott went over all the details with me.the actual install was alot faster than i thought it would be, from when i signed the contract to the system being installed was less than 2 weeks,on the installation day, jake held my hand through the app set up and showed me how to use the system.overall very impressed by the performance so far, i think ive paid a total of $12 so far since installation so im happy as larry!

Expert Electrical Tas were great from the start, where they listened to my needs, did not try to upsell unnecessarily and were happy to answer all my silly questions. They provided comprehensive information and clear options with pros and cons. A few mix ups with emails were smoothly and patiently dealt with.The install was great - very smooth, and when my old house brought unexpected surprises they were clear in the options I had and the risks and benefits of each. The team were prompt, polite, and friendly. They worked hard and refused cake (perhaps their only flaw)!It is rare that you find a company that will give unbiased and supportive customer service in all parts of the purchase and installation.

Quoting was excellent, provided a number of different options and price points and happy to then arrange an alternative mix.Installation was easy as, barely knew they were there, overall tidy and polite
Fine, fitted in June 2023

We recently had a large 13kW Solar system installed on our roof by Scott, Tony and the team at Expert Electrical Tasmania. What a fantastic end result, we are very happy with their work!!In addition to the standard solar install they first had to organise the removal of our old hot water solar system and a gas plumber to disconnect the gas boost. We then has another plumber fit the new electrical hot water at the same time. All these moving parts & different trades were well organised and done very professionally. A special mention to Tom who even came to our property on his day off for the connection to ensure my wife and kids would have hot water for the weekend.The actual Solar install was led by Jake & his team of 3 other workers. It was a hive of organised activity as they completed the entire install in 1 day including wifi connectivity and everything!Fantastic job guys, very happy to have used your services. Will definitely have more work for your office at our property in future and are recommending to our friends. My Dad has already had your business install solar on his place also on the back of my recommendation :)Finally, a thanks to Scott & Tony who were very helpful and informative in coaching me through the process to secure the 0% finance fee's scheme currently available in Tasmania. It was very simple and swift. This allowed us to borrow & invest an additional $10K on an interest free loan above our original budget. We used this for a much bigger system and the electrical hot water switch over which I feel is a great long term move.5 star across the board - thanks!!

Sales person excellent - provided multiple options, responsive to changes, good follow-upInstallation brought forward 3 weeks due to planned job cancelled which was great for us. Very efficient at installation done in great time. Warned of potential problems with new switch board which unfortunately did come to pass - they have organised electrician to come to sort this out.Good customer service all round.

I want energy & Expert electrical were both good with thier quoting-no complaints.Installation from Expert electrical was excellent & quick.Everything was done for me -all I had to do was pay the bill.
Thanks to the all the crew from quoting , being kept in the loop plus the installation crew great work and pleasure to deal with cheers
The sales and quoting process was very efficient and informative. Installation went smoothly and the crew were punctual and very pleasant. Customer service five stars.

All the staff I dealt with at Expert Electrical were professional, responsive, informative and, unlike one other company, didn't try to push me into making a quick decision based on getting a cheaper deal if I did. The installers were punctual, friendly and tidy and my grid connection was seamless.

My house is an architecturally designed passive solar home, Expert Electrical understood the difficulty in building a "different" house 20 years ahead of it's time.The electrical and physical construction was performed safely and to specifications of the Electrical Authority and to the requirements of an architecturally designed roof curved through 180 degrees.The administration and communications throughout the project where very much appreciated.

I was so impressed with the entire experience with Expert Electrical Tasmania. I can't rate them highly enough.Carson, who quoted, was friendly, punctual and responsive, not the slightest bit pushy, and was able to answer all my questions in detail (and patiently!).Chris, who liaised with me to follow up and confirm the paperwork, was professional, friendly and informative.Tony, who kept me updated on the time of the installation and checked in immediately after to ensure the team had done a good job, was top-notch in terms of communicating what was happening and/or what might have changed in terms of timing.And Jake and the team, who did the hard work installing my 30 panels, were fast, professional, punctual, friendly, respectful and knowledgeable. And they tidied and cleaned up after themselves!The system was working immediately, and I'm stoked with the way it's going, even after only a short time.Thanks to Expert Electrical. I couldn't be happier! And thanks to SolarQuotes for helping me find the right installers to deal with.

Awesome customer service and professionalism from quoting throu to installation and energisation. The process was quick and simple and they were happy to answer all our questions and help us through everything. Our bills are a fraction of what they were and we love opening the app to see how little we are using now

Expert Electrical were easy to deal with and listened to my requirements and preferences before providing three quotes.  The installation process went smoothly and I'm confident that I've got an excellent system within my budget.
Happy with every aspect. Friendly staff. Good quoting process. Prompt installation.
These company was easy to deal with; friendly, responsive and efficient.

Very happy with Expert Electrical Tas, and their off site system design and discussions made me choose them over the others. I advised all quoting companies that my house had a few potential installation issues (3 phase, parapet walls, salt water spray, sky lights & cable run location issues etc.) and I wanted a site measure up before the quotation.EET came to site and measured my roof for the maximum amount of panels that they could fit and quoted me a 25 panel 10.375kW system. I accepted their quotation but when their installation crew & electrician came to site they said that they could only fit a 22 panel 9.13kw system on the roof. The discount offered was only $600 less which seemed a bit light on for 3 panels (including 3 Tigo optimizers) on a separate roof along with less bracketing and cabling. This left me feeling a bit ripped off as the boss of EET was the one who had measured up.But despite the slightly smaller system, Im happy with the install works and very happy with the performance (so far, but I have not received my 1st bill yet)

I found all those that I spoke with at Expert Electrical to be very professional. They where generous with their time answering all my questions. The electricians that installed my system did a great job.

Out of the 3 companies that contacted me, Expert Electrical was the 2nd to contact me. The sales guys was very pleasant and easy to deal with, conversations felt more casual vs a sales pitch which was very nice. Quotes came in fairly quickly and often replied to my email within the hour of me sending them on any clarifying questions that I had. No pressure was applied to me at any point. I took a couple days to read and sign the contract. Booked in install was about 6 weeks after signing the contract. about a week later Expert Electrical called and asked if they could bring the install forward 4 weeks, I gladly accepted.They were very professional, with dealing with them. Expert Electrical do not install the solar system themselves, they subcontract it out, Derwent Electrical was the electrician that installed my solar system and they did an excellent job.The biggest issues I have had was nothing to do with the install itself or Expert Electrical1) First Energy took a long time (11 business days) before they allowed me to turn the system on, for some unknown reason.2) The SMA app (I have a SMA inverter) seems to be having issues (and looking online it has for the past 6 months) where it just doesn't work half the time. It loads the information from their website. You open the app and its basically a coin flip if it's going to work. I have found going to the website or logging onto the inverter directly does the jobAgain, nothing bad about the installer or install, but some notes worth noting about other factors.Overall, happy customer.

I enjoyed meeting Scott from Expert electrical on Zoom. The quote was done without a site visit. I selected the Australian made panels even though these were a slightly dearer option, hopefully the quality will prove superior and I am very happy to be supporting Australian industry.The installation was organised within 3 weeks of my accepting the quote which is a much quicker turn-around than the competitors, and the installer was polite quick and efficient. However I think the roof would look neater if the rails for the panels were cut off flush, they seem to be visible sticking out slightly at the edges of the panels.The panels have only been up a week so it is too soon to say how well they are working.I have not yet been able to log in to the online tools to see the graphs of energy production and useage, I could have done with a bit more help with getting that up and running.

From quote through installation and follow up has been a satisfying experience. The installation was offered in advance due to postponement by another customer which we gratefully accepted. The crew doing the installation were friendly, professional, efficient and left the site in a tidy condition. The solar panels are happily pumping out free power which will undoubtedly reduce our power bill significantly over the coming months and years. We are more than happy to recommend Expert Electrical Tasmania to provide you with a quality product and installation.

The whole process with Expert Electrical was really great, and I subsequently recommended them to my folks who had an equally excellent experience.I corresponded with three other companies. One didn’t fill me with confidence when I spoke to them over the phone so I didn’t pursue. The second were more interested in trying to offer me a discount for putting up advertising than telling me about their service/system (wasn’t recommended to them via this website). The third was an $8000 quote and they were super friendly but they didn’t know much about the actual system they were quoting, and I had to follow up with them a lot, and that was during the sales process (which didn’t fill me with confidence about chasing them up later, if needed).By comparison, Expert were more expensive but from the first interaction with them I felt confident and comfortable speaking with them. They passed the ‘can I ask them a stupid question’ test without feeling like I’ve asked a stupid question, and they passed with flying colours- which is very important to me as a single income, female household.They were responsive, followed up with me in a way that didn’t feel like they were pestering me, and in our initial meeting (online) talked me through all the options, how everything worked, etc. They had also identified that I needed a fuse board upgrade before work started (other groups hadn’t) and were willing to negotiate on a price that worked with my budget.The system was booked in for about a month after I paid the deposit but was moved forward two weeks when they had a gap in their schedule. The install itself, electrical box work and all, took about 5 hours. Their crew on-site identified an issue with my existing house wiring and fixed it, and we’re very professional/friendly. The work was signed off by the authorities less than a week later, and after a meter upgrade from my provider, was online within the fortnight.Thanks to the team, I’m very happy and looking forward to reporting back on its performance. So far, highly recommended.Some tips for those in Tassie that weren’t on the this website (that I wish I’d known):- since Oct 2022 the tas gov has energy saver loans, where you can apply for interest free loans for 1-3 years to have solar and other things up to the value of $10,000. It’s all organised through the provider and you just complete a simple application. I did this with a 3 year period, it’s costing $64 a week, no up front deposit, no fees, and the process was super smooth. With this and the rebate, it makes it a great time to get solar and didn’t put too much pressure on me financially.-be aware of the process around the installation and related timeframes to avoid disappointment. You can’t just switch the system on after it’s been installed. It needs to be certified by Tas Networks (apparently can take up to 4-6 weeks, 4-7 months if a major network upgrade is needed!!!) and your energy provider may need to upgrade your meter, even if it’s already a smart meter.
At this stage we are true believers, job done on time and on budget  Installers all good blokes easy to be around  Carson always on line with any questions from us no problems as yet all good.

Good explanation on what they had to offer and the price was reasonable for what I wanted.  Installation went well, people doing the installation were nice as well as tidy and punctual.  Had an issue with the network but the company worked with them to get it all up and running.

The whole process was great. We utilized the Tas government loan scheme.Rain delayed the install, but the guys got it done in just over half a day.The install looks great. Really neat with no exposed conduit.I was able to switch the system on the following day!

The sales/quoting process was very good, informative and answered all my questions.The installation was delayed and some confusion over dates (dates were changed 3 times), and a lack of communication. The installers were great, and talked to us throughout the installation.Customer service was poor. No follow up after installation. No information provided with regard to explaining or assisting with monitoring software, etc. Only after we asked for the links and warranty information, was it provided. No overall explanation of the process.  Apparently their side of the contract ended with the installation!Disappointing. But the system is good and it works, saving us bucks so far. Looking forward to how it copes with winter.

Initial contact was with Scott through a Zoom meeting, a great way to get heaps of information and to meet the people at the same time. So much better than a phone call.We chose to go with a top quality system using German Solarwatt panels and an SMA inverter. We also opted for a hot water timer, energy consumption meter and our aging switchboard needed upgrading as well.There was a bit of mucking around initially with the install subbie moving the install date a couple of times and the actual install had a couple of hiccups but Expert were extremely quick to rectify the problems and within a couple of days we had a fully functioning high quality system.Watching the figures on the SMA sunnyportal website showing how much our system is generating and how much we are saving is almost mesmerising. I can't wait to see the first power bill, it's going to be significantly less than previously!I would be more than happy to use Expert Electrical again.

Friendly and informative quote process undertaken in an efficient way. I was lucky that the house/roof design allowed a very simple installation. A window came up early for the installation and the crew were on site the next day and the system was installed and operational in no time. They were efficient, polite and tidy, what more could you ask for. No problems whatsoever.

Very Happy with the service.  Answered all our questions before and post-install.  The install crew were friendly and cleaned up after themselves.  We have had our system up for some months now and are happy to report that their after-sales service is great.

Tony and team from Expert Electrical have done a fantastic job on our large solar plus SunnyBoy battery system. Their communication, price, and follow up service have been fantastic, particularly with ironing out any of the kinks that cropped up once the service was up and running. Very highly recommended company, and definitely get a quote from them before you start!
Great customer care and service before and after installationInstallation went well very professional

What I like most, is we had more than 30 minutes online meeting (or presentation) before quotation and making this informed decision of what is best for my situation, and I have a visual image of what the monitoring system will look like. The process is smooth and professional, and with the heater timer on the panel, I can now harvest most of my solar energy for my own use!

I was referred to Expert Electrical Tasmania by a friend who had their system installed by them.I got some quotes from other companies in the area but their products did not appear to be as good.I called and they arranged a virtual appointment for me with Scott, which was very informative and well presented, and sent me a quote with several system plans because I was so indecisive at first. I requested a further site inspection just to make to sure of a few things and Scott was more than happy to help me with this. They organised all the paperwork and contacted my power supplier too.I bought a 6.6kwh SolarWatt/SMA system in mid May 2022 and it was installed (and running) by the end of May. The installation was very tidy and the installers, Sam and Jake, answered all my questions while they were working. Expert Electrical even called me to check that everything went well and to help me set up my monitoring app.I am very happy I went with them!
Very happy so far …just waiting for smart meter installation so we can start using the system!
Very happy with the quoting and installation from Expert Electrical.
No hassles, great price, great customer service and followed up a few months later to see how everything is going, would recommend.
We are extremely happy with our Solar the team were great to deal with and the installation was greatThank you for our great solar system

Very grateful to be put in contact with Scott and Tony from Expert Electrical Tasmania via SolarQuotes. I had been finding it difficult to get information and a quote for an off-grid system in Southern Tasmania. Scott was very helpful and knowledgeable with some great advice. They were able to install in a much quicker time frame than the other companies I contacted and their communication and follow-up so far has been great. System working well so far and remote monitoring system is easy to use.

Original contact was prompt and received quotes on good, better and best systems within 48 hours of the first visit. First installation date was put back by 3 weeks due to inclement weather affecting other jobs. Second date was met and 2 chaps did the installation in 1 day ( 25 panels, inverter , 25 Tigo optimisers and energy meter}. Solar was operational same day and Tony and Scott did the appropriate work within the next few days so that I could monitor the system. They also handled the paperwork, etc, with the energy supplier. The 2 subbies used for the installation were excellent tradesmen and good workers. They did a very professional and tidy job. Customer service in the main was very good. Had a couple of communication problems early on - probably because of some confusion with which email addresses to use. Expert Electrical were the most expensive of the 3 quotes received but I asked for what I believed was the best equipment available and they had the gear in stock. (Paid $14,280 incl $800 for switchboard upgrade ). Have saved over $600 from 23/12/21 to 9/2/22. More than happy with the whole deal.
*****  No problem's  100 % 5  STARS for all concerned. We are very happy with price a and installation. Thank you so very much,Thank you & regards,Robert & Jann.

The sales and quoting process was very friendly and informative, with a prompt appointment and an efficient assessment of the peculiarities of the site.  Excellent links and videos were sent with the quote, which was received several days later.  For a visual thinker the information presented was much easier to absorb than a lot of statistics and graphs, which can be overwhelming when trying to comparatively understand the differences between solar systems and components.Once the deposit was paid EE made a request to upgrade to a digital meter and both TasNetworks and Aurora were very efficient with updates on the progress from booking a date to the arrival of the installer, which was done within 2 weeks.  EE installation of the solar system occurred on the date booked with an extremely efficient team with an app link sent once remote reading of the system had been set up.  The customer service was excellent and I have no hesitation in approaching them with questions or further information.  Now we just have to change our daytime electrical use and learn how to read the data to make the most of the solar energy we generate.

I went with Expert Electrical because I liked the idea that the sales person is the same person who would be leading the actual install (Scott). My install had some quirky aspects and I wanted to minimise the possibility of any miscommunications or surprises on install day. Ultimately the install went smoothly (despite a couple rain-outs) and I've been pleased with the kit so far and with the SMA app. I would recommend Scott and Expert Electrical to anybody. Their pricing was as sharp as any other quote I recieved, and the SMA kit has a great reputation.Other things I appreciated about Expert Electrical:- They also installed my EV charger (a Zappi v1 I purchased secondhand) for me on the same day (which saved me some labour cost by doing everything at once) and made for a big day of installing, but they stayed late and got it all done in a day. They also had to do some long cable runs and to extend a CT clamp, but they figured it out and it works great and correctly monitors and captures my grid exports.- They managed to fit in everything I wanted (PV + consumption meter + EV charger + hot water timer) to my existing sub-board, which ended up using every millimeter of available space. I imagine it would have been easy for a lesser sparky to declare it impossible and make me pay for a sub-board upgrade, but Scott and Danny figured it out, and I am grateful.- They gamely put up with my energetic puppy supervising the entire install, including when he ran off with the hot water timer4/5 stars for customer service - they're a small team and they spend a fair portion of their week on roofs, so emailing and office admin does not appear to be their greatest strength. It took some doing to get the quotes and invoicing straight, but we got there in the end.All in all very pleased with my choice so far, would recommend Scott and his team to anybody (and I already have!).

The initial sales process was very smooth, they came to our house and discussed the different options.  I was a little surprised that there wasn't really much discussion about our power usage, but was impressed with their overall knowledge of solar panels and inverters.  Having spent a lot of time reading the Solar Quotes website I felt confident that they knew what they were talking about and weren't talking BS.We were given four different price points to choose from and the pros and cons of each were explained.  A quote was provided the same day.  We had to go back and forth a little to get the details of the contract right, but after signing and paying the deposit we were given an installation date that was only about four weeks away.We were pleased to find that the system was installed on the agreed date.  Installation was subcontracted to "In Series Electrical and Solar".  We don't have any complaints about that though, the the installers were very polite and professional and did a great job.  The Hyundai panels look great on the roof too!We paid a little extra to also install an SMA energy meter. The 390 W panels were larger than were allowed for in the design.  The installers had to position them differently.2. The SMA energy meter was wired back to front.  This meant that imported power was reported exported and exported power was recorded as imported.  It caused some confusion when I first looked at the reports.
